title: When Figures Disagree with Text: Evaluating Autonomous Visual Evidence Verification in Scientific Papers
abstract: arXiv:2611.24353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific figures carry evidence for the claims that cite them, so reviewing a paper means checking that a figure agrees with the text, and not only describing what the figure shows. Benchmarks of figure-text verification typically hand the model the figure, the claim, or the knowledge that an inconsistency exists, which leaves untested whether a model can find the figure worth checking in a complete paper, relate a visual element to the claim it conflicts with, and recognize the conflict. We study this autonomous setting on 31 full manuscripts, each carrying a reviewer-documented figure-text inconsistency from PRISMM-Bench that is hidden from the model. Six multimodal models review each PDF under a neutral prompt, and we then add one input at a time to the same manuscripts. Of 1,445 open-ended reviews, 60.6% mention the flawed figure, yet a grading rubric accepts only 3.3% as diagnosing its contradiction; a blind audit finds the rubric

translated_title: 当图表与文本不一致时：评估科学论文中的自主视觉证据验证
translated_abstract: 科学图表为其被引用的论断提供证据支持，因此审阅一篇论文意味着检查图表与文本是否一致，而不仅仅是描述图表展示的内容。现有的图文一致性验证基准通常直接向模型提供图表、相关论断，或告知模型存在不一致的信息，这使得模型能否在完整论文中自行找到值得检查的图表、将视觉元素与其冲突的论断关联起来并识别出冲突，这些问题都未被测试。我们在31篇完整稿件上研究这种自主设置，每篇稿件都包含一个来自PRISMM-Bench的、经审稿人记录且对模型隐藏的图文不一致问题。六个多模态模型在中性提示下审阅每个PDF，随后我们在相同稿件上逐一添加额外输入。在1,445份开放式审阅中，60.6%提到了存在缺陷的图表，然而评分标准仅接受其中3.3%为真正诊断出该矛盾；一项盲审发现该评分标准……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种更贴近真实审稿场景的自主图文一致性验证评估，要求多模态模型在无任何提示的情况下于完整论文中自行定位问题图表并诊断矛盾，结果显示尽管60.6%的审阅提及了缺陷图表，但仅3.3%真正诊断出了其中的不一致。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an autonomous evaluation of figure-text consistency verification, requiring multimodal models to locate problematic figures in full manuscripts without hints; while 60.6% of 1,445 open-ended reviews mentioned the flawed figure, only 3.3% actually diagnosed the contradiction.
